notes.title: Welcome everyone!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34267068/67edfa3c4c8ce825d38bff946d37a0c52483e1d8.png[/img]

Thank you for your support, and feedback after playing Circle Rally Party!

My mind is flooding with ideas about things to possibly add to the game. I'll need your help to determine what to focus on next. What would you love to see in Circle Rally Party?

[b]What's next:[/b]
For now, the focus will be mainly on adding more cars with unique powers, and mini games to the game. Eventually there'll be a little racing mode for a bit of variation between mini games.

[b]How do I send feedback?[/b]
If you are willing to give feedback on the game, please feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/SGfYDwc]join the Discord server[/url] or message me on [url=https://twitter.com/yvogdev]Twitter[/url] (@yvogdev).

Have a good game night!

Cheers,

Yvo
